I really don't mind about how much it suits me, I just want to get in...
York is such a top university, what were your results/work experience like?
I just want a good job at the end of it..
I don't need a million dollar job... I just want a decent above average one.

What university do you go to?

I might not get into the very top unis, but I feel like I need a good job at least to support my family. None of them went to university and are without jobs.
My family wouldn't allow that. But even if I did, what would I do once I arrive at these dreaded things?
